title: Google unveils Operation Blue Skies, a £5M trial to re-route North Atlantic aircraft to reduce contrail-induced warming using Google's AI atmospheric forecasts (Madeleine Cuff/New Scientist)
summary: Madeleine Cuff / New Scientist: Google unveils Operation Blue Skies, a £5M trial to re-route North Atlantic aircraft to reduce contrail-induced warming using Google's AI atmospheric forecasts — Operation Blue Skies is the world's first trial to deploy contrail avoidance measures across an entire airspace …
